rationale: Iranian strikes on US bases continue as known background; Fed rate hike already scored last cycle; no new qualitative change affecting Poland's security or economy this cycle.

top_events.title: Photos show widespread damage at US sites from Iranian attacks
top_events.label: Iranian strikes damage US bases confirmed
top_events.summary: Images confirm wrecked aircraft and destroyed buildings at US military sites from Iranian attacks. Continues known Middle East escalation with indirect implications for NATO ally Poland.

top_events.title: Congress passes sweeping US sanctions bill targeting Russia
top_events.label: US Congress passes Russia sanctions bill
top_events.summary: First Ukraine-support legislation in over two years from US Congress. Strengthens Western pressure on Russia, indirectly supporting Poland's eastern security concerns.

top_events.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
top_events.label: EU backs Canada associate membership plan
top_events.summary: EU supports closer Canada ties amid US-Canada trade tensions. Potential economic benefit for Poland through expanded EU trade network, though Trump threatens tariffs in response.

short_summary: US Fed raises rates despite Trump opposition

most_significant_event.label: US Fed raises rates despite Trump opposition
most_significant_event.summary: Federal Reserve hiked rates unanimously despite fierce presidential opposition calling for cuts. This tightens global financial conditions, raising borrowing costs for Poland and EU economies.
